appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Theme, accent colour, density and motion. Saved in this browser.

about.title: About
about.description: Version, licence and where your data lives.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Used for focus, selection and primary actions.

motion.label: Motion
motion.description: Reduce turns animations into simple fades. Your system setting always applies.

about.tagline: A local-first, keyboard-driven workspace for designing, sending and understanding HTTP requests.
about.storageValue: Stored only in this browser. API Studio has no account and sends no telemetry.

collections.title: Collections
collections.emptyDescription: Collections group related requests into folders you can share and export.

history.title: History
history.emptyDescription: Every request you send is recorded here, grouped by day.

environments.title: Environments
environments.emptyDescription: Environments hold values such as a base URL or a token for each stage, like local, staging and production.

variables.title: Variables
variables.emptyDescription: Variables are reusable values you can insert into any request field.

editor.emptyDescription: Requests open here in tabs. Start a new one, or open one from your collections.

response.title: Response
response.emptyDescription: Send a request to see its status, timing, headers and body here.

console.title: Console
console.emptyDescription: Requests and app events are logged here as they happen.

nameDialog.createDescription: A workspace holds its own collections, environments and history.
nameDialog.renameDescription: The new name shows everywhere this workspace appears.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{name}”?
deleteDialog.description: Its collections, requests and environments are deleted from this browser. This cannot be undone.

errors.invalid_name: Enter a name of 1 to {max} characters.
errors.last_workspace: You need at least one workspace.
errors.storage: Your change could not be saved. Check that this browser allows site storage, then try again.

notFound.title: Workspace not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted in another tab, or the link comes from another browser.

params.queryDescription: Kept in step with the URL: edit either one.
params.pathDescription: Write :name in the URL path to add one.

headers.title: Headers
headers.generatedDescription: API Studio adds these unless you write a header with the same name.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Sent in a Cookie header with this request.

descriptions.inherit: Uses the auth of the nearest folder or collection that sets one.
descriptions.basic: Sends a username and password in the Authorization header.
descriptions.bearer: Sends a token in the Authorization header.
descriptions.api_key: Sends a key and value in a header or the query string.
descriptions.oauth2: Paste an access token to send it as a bearer token. Token requests arrive in a later version.

auth.inheritedNothing: Nothing to inherit: no folder or collection above this request sets auth.

body.noneDescription: Pick a body type to send JSON, text, XML or a form.
body.binaryTitle: File bodies arrive in a later version
body.binaryDescription: Until then, send the content as text or as form data.
body.formatFailed: The body is not valid JSON, so it was left as it is.

settings.timeoutDescription: How long to wait for a response, in milliseconds.
settings.outOfRange: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

conflict.title: This request was changed elsewhere
conflict.description: It was saved in another tab or window after you started editing.

saveDialog.title: Save request
saveDialog.description: Pick where the request goes. You can move it later.
saveDialog.newCollectionDescription: You have no collections yet, so one is created.

errors.needs_location: Pick where to save this request.
errors.invalid_name: Enter a name of 1 to {max} characters.
errors.storage: The request could not be saved. Check that this browser allows site storage, then try again.

toasts.autoSaveFailed: Your open tabs could not be saved in this browser. Changes stay here until the next attempt.
toasts.restoreFailed: Your open tabs could not be restored. Check that this browser allows site storage, then reload.

requestBuilder.tabName: {method} {name}{pinned, select, true {, pinned} other {}}{dirty, select, true {, unsaved changes} other {}}

closeDialog.title: {count, plural, one {Close “{title}” without saving?} other {Close # tabs without saving?}}
closeDialog.description: {count, plural, one {Its changes are lost.} other {Their changes are lost.}}

TIMEOUT.label: Timed out
TIMEOUT.title: The request timed out
TIMEOUT.description: No complete response arrived within the request's timeout.
TIMEOUT.action: Raise the timeout in the request's Settings, or check that the server answers.

ABORTED.label: Cancelled
ABORTED.title: Request cancelled
ABORTED.description: You cancelled the request before a response arrived.

NETWORK.label: Network error
NETWORK.title: Could not connect
NETWORK.description: The connection failed or was closed before a response arrived.
NETWORK.action: Check that the server is running and the URL and port are right. In browser mode, the API must allow CORS.

DNS.label: Host not found
DNS.title: The host name did not resolve
DNS.description: No address was found for the host in the URL.
DNS.action: Check the host name for typos, and that your network can resolve it.

TLS.label: TLS error
TLS.title: The secure connection failed
TLS.description: The server's certificate was not accepted, or the TLS handshake failed.
TLS.action: Check the certificate, or use http:// for a local server without one.

BLOCKED_ADDRESS.label: Blocked
BLOCKED_ADDRESS.title: This address is not allowed
BLOCKED_ADDRESS.description: This proxy does not reach private or local addresses, or that port.
BLOCKED_ADDRESS.action: Switch to browser mode to reach localhost from here.

TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS.label: Too many redirects
TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS.title: Too many redirects
TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS.description: The server kept redirecting past the request's limit.
TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS.action: Raise the redirect limit in the request's Settings, or turn off following redirects to see the first one.

REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.label: Request too large
REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.title: The request body is too large
REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.description: The body is larger than the proxy accepts.

INVALID_REQUEST.label: Invalid request
INVALID_REQUEST.title: The request is not valid
INVALID_REQUEST.description: Check the URL and header names.

UNRESOLVED_VARIABLES.label: Unresolved variables
UNRESOLVED_VARIABLES.title: Some variables have no value
UNRESOLVED_VARIABLES.description: Define them in an environment or the workspace, or remove them from the request.

PROXY_UNAVAILABLE.label: Proxy unavailable
PROXY_UNAVAILABLE.title: The proxy did not answer
PROXY_UNAVAILABLE.description: API Studio's server could not be reached or failed.
PROXY_UNAVAILABLE.action: Check that the app's server is running, or switch to browser mode.

responseViewer.binaryBody: A {type} body of {size}. Previews for images and other binary bodies arrive with the response viewers.

summary.truncated: Body cut at the size limit
